newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 19.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Talks begin on ending student unrest in Ivory Coast's

- African Development Bank information day in Ivory Coast offered good news for private sector in need of investment but deserved better turnout - Experts meet in Ivory Coast's commercial capital Abidjan to discuss livestock rearing. - Ivory Coast to participate in Paris's international agriculture show

- Students demand recognition of FESCI student federation during talks with university authorities on crisis in higher education in Ivory Coast. Government says FESCI was banned but opposition and human rights groups dispute this.
- Opposition Ivorian Popular Front to take government newspaper group to court for defamation over reports linking it to Ivory Coast's unversity crisis.
- Ivorian National Union of Traders SYNACCI to organise first
